# Hong Life Calculators

> honglifecalc.com offers free, no-sign-up calculators for tax, salary, mortgage, loans, benefits and everyday math, organised by country in each country's own language, plus general calculators in English. Calculations run in the browser; inputs are not sent to a server.

Each country page states the tax year and links its official sources (tax authority, statistics office, regulator) with a last-checked date. Results are estimates, not tax, legal or financial advice. About: https://honglifecalc.com/about.html · Privacy: https://honglifecalc.com/privacy.html
